name: cache-key-classification-folding
body:
Provenance and reconciliation for the classification-config-in-cache-key change-set.

PROVENANCE. The fix previously landed at commit `cbb2cd69` ("fold classification config into the scan cache key") and was reverted by `d68c1c07` as out-of-scope for the apg-cleanup refactor-only change-set ("handed to a separate project"). Recovered from `cbb2cd69` and adapted to the decomposed layout: the original patch touched `src/cache.rs`, `src/cache/tests.rs`, `src/lib.rs`; the layout has since been decomposed, so it now maps to `src/cache/manifest.rs`, `src/cache/tests.rs`, `src/scan.rs`.

RECONCILIATION (coverage). `domain.value.cache-key` is named by code doc-comments — `rust.apg.cache`'s module docs, `rust.apg.cache.manifest.CacheKey`'s doc, and `rust.apg.frontends`' `--cache-key` hand-off doc — and is the value the requirement folds the classification component into. But a Value cannot originate a `realised-by` edge (the SPEC §3.3 matrix at `src/layers/validate.rs` allows group/entity/service only), and `coverage_check` (`src/plan_cmd/verify.rs`) derives solution coverage by walking `drives` → `realised-by` only — it never follows `contains` — so a Value alone leaves the change-set's code with no derived solution and unenforced by `apg plan verify`. The requirement therefore ALSO drives the narrow entity `domain.entity.classification-config`, which is `realised-by` the narrow `solution.component.cache-classification-key`; that component is `implemented-by` exactly the classification-key code — `rust.apg.cache.manifest.ScanConfigKey`, `rust.apg.cache.manifest.CacheKey.compute`, and `rust.apg.scan.cmd_scan`. Coverage now reaches those three code FQNs through `requirement → entity → realised-by → component → implemented-by`. The requirement keeps its `drives` → `domain.value.cache-key` edge, recording that the classification identity is folded into the cache-key value; the value contributes no solution because a Value has no `realised-by`. Driving `domain.group.graph-identity` was deliberately avoided: that would pull the whole of `solution.component.scan-driver` into derived solution coverage and force every one of its unrelated pre-existing `implemented-by` targets to be touched by a task. The narrow component is also branch-added, so coverage enforces it on this branch independently of the spine walk. [autonomous]

SIBLING, NOT DUPLICATED. The scan blacklist is NOT folded into the cache key — a separate known limitation documented in `requirements.note.blacklist-not-in-cache-key`, explicitly out of scope here. The two are separate gaps in the same key. This note cannot carry a `details` edge to that note: the load model deliberately refuses `Note`→`Note` `Details` (`src/load/tables.rs`), even though the write-time validator accepts the target, so a `details` edge there is written to the node files and then silently dropped from the graph — it was removed. [observed inconsistency; relation recorded here in prose and through the shared `requirements.requirement.fast-project-start` target]

PLANNED (not yet in the graph, so deliberately NOT `implemented-by` targets): the plan-writer declares `rust.apg.cache.manifest.classification_digest` and `rust.apg.cache.manifest.classification_render` as planned nodes.
